title: Herald FAQ document
description: Schema for a Herald FAQ document. One file per product surface (e.g. herald-oss.json). The document is organised into named sections; each section holds one or more Q&A items. The website consumer renders sections in array order and items inside a section in array order. Answers are HTML strings rather than markdown because several existing items need block markup (tables, code blocks, router-link) that survives v-html rendering more cleanly than a markdown-to-HTML pipeline.

surface.description: Short identifier for the product surface this FAQ covers (e.g. 'herald-oss', 'herald-pro', 'tesseraseal'). Used as the file slug and as a deep-link namespace.

version.description: ISO-8601 date of the document's last substantive update (YYYY-MM-DD). Bumped any time an item is added, removed, or revised in a way that changes meaning.

title.description: Human-readable title for the FAQ document, rendered on the page hero. Inline emphasis tags (<em>, <strong>) permitted.

lead.description: Optional one-paragraph introduction shown above the first section. Plain text or limited inline HTML (em, strong, code, a).

sections.description: Ordered list of FAQ sections. The consumer renders them in array order; the rail navigation lists section titles in the same order.

id.description: URL-safe slug for the section, unique within the document. Used as the rail anchor and for deep-linking (e.g. /herald/faq#getting-started).

title.description: Section heading rendered as the rail label and the section header in the content column.

lead.description: Optional one-line summary shown under the section title before the first item. Plain text or limited inline HTML.

items.description: Ordered list of Q&A entries in this section. The consumer renders them in array order; collapsed by default with the first item in the first section expanded on landing.

id.description: URL-safe slug, unique within the document. Used for deep-linking (e.g. /herald/faq#license-and-repo) and as the expansion-panel value.

question.description: Plain-text question. No HTML; the consumer renders this in the panel header.

answer_html.description: HTML answer body. Permitted markup: p, ul, ol, li, strong, em, code, pre, a, br, table/thead/tbody/tr/th/td, router-link. The consumer renders this verbatim into a v-html target; the document author is responsible for keeping it safe to render (no script, no inline event handlers).

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for client-side filtering or search (e.g. 'license', 'aot', 'pricing'). The consumer may render these as chips above each item.

see_also.description: Optional related-reading links rendered as a 'See also' footer under the answer. Use sparingly — only when a reader who just finished this answer is likely to want the linked page next.

updated.description: ISO-8601 date this item was last revised (YYYY-MM-DD). Used by docs tooling to flag stale items; not always rendered.
